text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) can cause common mild side effects as well as serious, life-threatening complications.

list.snippet: Increased urination and thirst: Passing more frequent or larger volumes of urine and waking up at night because the kidneys flush out excess sugar.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning, urgency, frequency, or cloudy/bloody urine caused by bacteria growing in sugar-rich urine.
Genital yeast infections: Itching, redness, burning, pain, swelling, or a thick white discharge in women or men.
Dehydration and low blood pressure: Dizziness, lightheadedness, or feeling faint when standing up.
Other mild effects: Joint pain, upper respiratory infections, or mild nausea.

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood, which can happen even if blood sugar is not extremely high (symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, fruity breath, fatigue, and trouble breathing).
Necrotizing fasciitis (Fournier's gangrene): A rare, life-threatening bacterial infection of the tissue under the skin in the perineum (area between the genitals and rectum).
Severe kidney infections or sudden kidney injury: Pyelonephritis, urosepsis, or a sharp drop in kidney function linked to severe dehydration.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if Jardiance is taken alongside other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas.
Lower limb amputations: An increased risk of leg or foot sores, ulcers, or amputations, particularly in people with pre-existing vascular disease.
Serious allergic reactions: Rashes, hives, or swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat.
